title: Week 14 R2 levers, pre-registered before any run
lock_rule: The criteria and the kill lines in this file were frozen before the levers were executed. They are never relaxed afterwards. Any lever that does not clear its criterion is reported as failed, not as a trend.
why_this_is_the_week: Appendix X carries the R2 programme. Levers 2, 3 and 7 are the three half-day items; this file locks what counts as a pass before a single number is produced.

main_scoreboard.definition: the 457 room-band rows of the 97 v11 compounds that carry xTB features, exactly as dealt by probes/dielectric_coverage_paired_benchmark.py
main_scoreboard.fold_dealing: a fresh permutation of the sorted compound keys per repeat, dealt round-robin, whole compounds
main_scoreboard.score_mask: masked_splits(groups, score_mask, train_mask, ...) over the paired_base masks of the coverage benchmark
main_scoreboard.frozen: the scored rows, the fold assignment and the metric denominator never change inside Week 14. Only the training side and the feature side may change.

reference_reading_to_reproduce_first.aggregation: mean over fold rows of the grouped repeats
reference_reading_to_reproduce_first.rule: every lever report must re-run the untouched baseline arm first and quote its own reproduced value next to the published one. A lever whose baseline arm does not reproduce is stamped unverified and no delta from it may be quoted.

metric_contract.delta_sign: delta is always lever minus the baseline arm re-run inside the same script, on the same folds
metric_contract.leak_reference: row-level random_row splits appear at most once per report, clearly labelled, and never enter a pass or a fail

control_arm.name: dummy_control
control_arm.rule: each lever carries a shuffled-label control on its own feature block: the same folds, the same model, the target permuted. A lever may only be called real if its control collapses (|delta R2| <= 0.02).
control_arm.why: the S-5 three-arm placebo tradition is carried forward. A lever that cannot beat its own placebo is not a finding.

shots_policy.rule: every scored attempt at the main scoreboard is counted, including failed and abandoned ones. The count is written into reports/decisions_log.md section 12 and into each lever summary.
shots_policy.why: twenty shots with one hit is not a discovery, it is multiple-comparison noise.

levers.hypothesis: the largest error block is the associating liquids (33.7 percent of rows, MAE 11.5). The frozen v03 physical block carries only bulk hbd/hba counts, so it cannot see donor-acceptor competition or site density. Six new RDKit-computed descriptors, added to the frozen block without touching any existing column, should recover part of that block.
new_features: hbond_donor_sites (RDKit Lipinski NumHDonors, recomputed from SMILES rather than read from the frozen table)
intramolecular_hbond_competition (count of donor-acceptor pairs within three bonds, SMARTS based: vicinal and 1,3 donor/acceptor motifs)
donor_acceptor_pair_density (donors times acceptors divided by heavy_atom_count squared)
levers.pass_criterion: grouped R2 on the main scoreboard increases by at least +0.0200 against the baseline arm re-run in the same script
levers.secondary_criterion: MAE on the mae_gt60 stratum must not increase, and the control arm must collapse
levers.kill_line: delta R2 below +0.0050, or any increase that survives only in MAE_gt60 while total R2 falls, or a control arm that does not collapse -> the lever is reported dead and its features are not carried into the merge arm

levers.short: log(epsilon-1) target with a Huber loss
levers.hypothesis: raw epsilon is long tailed. The log transform already proved its worth on rank (Spearman 0.880) but the R2 on the raw scale has never collected that dividend, because one squared-error outlier at epsilon 90 dominates the denominator. Training on log(epsilon-1) with a pseudo-Huber objective, then back-transforming to the raw scale before scoring, should lift raw-scale R2.
levers.transform: y_train = ln(epsilon - 1); prediction back-transformed as exp(y_hat) + 1
levers.model_change: objective reg:squarederror -> objective reg:pseudohubererror with huber_slope 1.0; every other frozen hyper-parameter unchanged
levers.pass_criterion: grouped R2 on the raw scale, on the main scoreboard, increases by at least +0.0200 against the baseline arm re-run in the same script
levers.secondary_criterion: Spearman must not fall, and the control arm (same transform, shuffled labels) must collapse
levers.kill_line: delta R2 below +0.0050 on the raw scale -> dead. A lift that exists only in log space and vanishes after back-transformation is not a lift and is reported as such.

levers.hypothesis: the standing complaint is variance, not bias. Bagging the frozen model over independent seeds on the identical folds should leave the mean R2 roughly where it is while narrowing the spread of the repeat-level readings.
levers.model_change: n_bags = 10 XGBRegressor members, identical frozen hyper-parameters, random_state = seed * 1000 + bag index, predictions averaged before scoring; feature subsampling left to the model's own colsample_bytree
levers.pass_criterion: mean grouped R2 must not fall by more than 0.0050, AND the standard deviation of the repeat-level R2 readings must shrink by at least 20 percent relative to the baseline arm
levers.secondary_criterion: no regression in MAE or in the mae_gt60 stratum beyond noise
levers.kill_line: mean R2 falls by more than 0.0050, or the standard deviation shrinks by less than 20 percent -> dead. A variance claim without a narrowed interval is not a result.
levers.expected_delta: about +0.01 on the mean; the real deliverable is the interval

merge_rule.rule: only levers that cleared their own criterion may be combined. The merge arm is re-scored on the main scoreboard, and its delta is reported against the best single passing lever as well as against the baseline, so a merge that adds nothing is visible.
merge_rule.if_nothing_passes: the merge arm is not run; the week reports three dead levers and keeps the 0.5454 reading untouched

forbidden: row-level random splits for any conclusion
letting test residuals steer feature selection
changing the score mask, the compound set or the fold numbers
quoting a delta against a baseline that was not re-run in the same script
quoting 0.5332 or 0.5454 next to the v1.0 headline 0.364 without their pool definitions

locked_constants_untouched.pass_expression: C1 and C2_solvent and C2_additive and C3
